title: Direct-Bill Installment Fee State Schedule — Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Company's own filed state schedule for direct-bill installments (no statute sets it).** Under the **Installment Payment Plans**, the first invoice after an owner plan is moved to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan carries as its installment fee the figure for the state in which the Owner Auto Policy term is garaged:

| Garaging state of the Owner Auto Policy term | Installment fee on the first invoice after the move |
|---|---|
| Florida | 6.00 |
| Georgia | 7.50 |
| Texas | 7.50 |
| Virginia | 9.00 (the plan's installment fee) |
| Ohio | 9.00 (the plan's installment fee) |
| Arizona | 9.00 (the plan's installment fee) |

The garaging state is read from the Owner Auto Policy term the plan bills.
